limits: one known proof and four corruptions; a proof is read as the sequence of its formulas' codes, never as its own Gödel number
name: W1_proof_checker

provenance.source: Gödel 1931, section 2, in Martin Hirzel's translation; The Gödel Method handover, W-1

statement: The checker of definitions 44 and 45 accepts a five-step proof of p ⇒ p in system P (p the elementary formula x2(x1), from the propositional schemas and modus ponens): accepted; and it rejects all 4 of 4 corruptions (f2 and f4 swapped, f2 dropped, the last formula changed, an axiom replaced by a non-axiom). The Peano axioms and the set axiom are the formulas with = expanded as in P.
